root_cause.text: The `teql` queuing discipline lacks a validation check during initialization to ensure it is only configured as a root qdisc, allowing it to be used as a child qdisc where its unique queue length update and peek behaviors cause state desynchronization and a use-after-free in parent classful qdiscs.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (sch->parent != TC_H_ROOT)` in `teql_qdisc_init` to reject non-root configurations, preventing a scenario where `teql`'s NULL-returning `peek` prevents `dequeue` from being called, leaving the parent-visible `qlen` at 0 and causing a use-after-free in the parent qdisc (e.g., QFQ) during class deactivation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Restrict TEQL qdisc initialization to the root position to prevent unsupported configurations.
intent_record.what: Adds a conditional check to verify if the parent of the Qdisc is TC_H_ROOT, returning -EOPNOTSUPP and setting an error message if it is not.
intent_record.how: Prevents the TEQL queuing discipline from being instantiated as a non-root child qdisc, enforcing its usage only at the root level.

candidates.rationale: This is the existing validation check during teql qdisc initialization. It fails to validate that the qdisc is being configured as a root qdisc (i.e., checking sch->parent == TC_H_ROOT), allowing it to be initialized as a child qdisc.
This statement initializes the teql private data structure without first verifying that the qdisc is configured as a root qdisc, leading to unsupported child qdisc configurations.
